startup_rule: Prefer the newest verified portable state/checkpoint artifact from current chat, Project Sources or Library.
Consult PROJECT-STATE.json and the relevant GitHub CHECKPOINT.json only as much as needed to resolve ambiguity or sync status.
Resolve the active START-PROMPT from active_framework.entrypoint; do not hard-code an older prompt version.
For v3.3.2, resolve the exact portable master prompt using active_framework.portable_authority and verify its recorded SHA-256.
Resolve registered raw sources from Project Sources first, then Library; do not ask the user to re-upload until both have been checked.
Inspect German-Flashcards-Pro only when runtime/import/presentation compatibility actually matters.
